- Seed: `1`

- Used complete fallback: `false`
- Fragment IDs: `foundation-trait-pressure-2`, `context-14`, `lg-ideals-alt`, `foundation-bond-place-1`, `lg-flaws`, `foundation-experience-rivalry-1`, `lg-choice`, `lg-motivation`

### Traits

- “When I enter a new place, I find the person doing necessary work without recognition.”
- “I pay close attention to the way a tool balances in my hand.”

### Ideal

- “A wrong left unspoken to keep the peace can harm the people that peace was meant to protect.”

### Bond

- “A neglected meeting place once sheltered me; I send what I can to keep its door open.”

### Flaw

- “I can be slow to forgive a broken promise, even when the person is trying to make amends.”

### Story

1. “A rival and I pursued the same prize until an accident put it beyond either of us alone. I offered a temporary partnership, and sharing the result saved our work while making the next contest far more personal.”
2. “When a promised escort became dangerous, I completed it instead of taking the safer road alone. We arrived late and indebted to those who aided us, so I no longer confuse keeping my word with carrying every burden myself.”
3. “I seek work that leaves vulnerable people safer, and I ask those affected what protection means before imposing my own solution.”

## sparse-ng

- Seed: `2`
- Alignment: `ng`

- Used complete fallback: `false`
- Fragment IDs: `context-24`, `context-17`, `ng-ideals`, `context-21`, `ng-flaws-alt`, `ambition-foundation-6`, `ng-choice-alt`, `ng-motivation`

### Traits

- “I use small tasks to give myself time to think.”
- “I pause to collect my thoughts before beginning an important task.”

### Ideal

- “Helping someone matters more to me than receiving credit for it.”

### Bond

- “I left a piece of work unfinished after someone said I could not complete it, and I still carry the part needed to resume.”

### Flaw

- “I assume others can manage without me and only notice my absence after something collapses.”

### Story

1. “I stayed after the others abandoned a difficult piece of work and repeated it until one small improvement finally held. Finishing alone earned me the result but cost me their help, so I now decide whether mastery or cooperation matters more before I begin.”
2. “When a friend asked me to take credit for their work, I refused and named them instead. The recognition they gained cost me a sponsor, and I still choose honesty over a faster rise.”
3. “I look for neglected problems where my abilities can make a measurable difference, especially when helping earns no audience or reward.”

## sparse-cg

- Seed: `3`
- Alignment: `cg`
- Theme: `ambition`
- Used complete fallback: `false`
- Fragment IDs: `context-23`, `context-15`, `cg-ideals`, `ambition-foundation-4`, `cg-flaws`, `foundation-experience-failure-1`, `cg-choice`, `cg-motivation`

### Traits

- “I arrange my belongings the same way whenever I stop to rest.”
- “I remember the rhythm of a conversation as clearly as its words.”

### Ideal

- “No custom deserves my loyalty when it is used to keep someone helpless.”

### Bond

- “I keep the failed first draft of a project I have sworn to complete.”

### Flaw

- “I rush to intervene before asking the people involved what help they actually want.”

### Story

1. “I volunteered to lead familiar work and dismissed a quieter person’s warning. The failure cost us our materials, and rebuilding under their plan taught everyone exactly whose judgment had been missing.”
2. “When an authority barred someone from leaving, I opened a way out without permission. The person rejected the route I chose but showed me another, and their escape taught me to pair defiance with listening.”
3. “I seek people trapped by coercive rules and offer them options, resources, and an exit without demanding that they choose my preferred path.”

### Traits

- “I pause to collect my thoughts before beginning an important task.”
- “I remember the small habits of people I spend time with.”

### Ideal

- “Belonging must be offered and renewed; no label gives one person ownership of another.”

### Bond

- “I was the only witness when someone made a costly promise, and I intend to see it remembered.”

### Flaw

- “I reject useful improvisation because it was not part of the plan I announced.”

### Story

1. “When I could not pay for something necessary, an acquaintance risked their standing to vouch for me. I accepted rather than go without, and their later disappearance left me carrying a debt with no obvious way to repay it.”
2. “When a shortcut would have met the deadline but violated the method I promised, I took the longer route and missed the reward. The work held, and I still treat the method as part of the obligation.”
3. “I seek a responsibility with clear standards and real consequences, where I can prove my code survives inconvenience without treating judgment as disobedience.”

### Traits

- “I notice small changes in the plants and animals around me.”
- “I pause to collect my thoughts before beginning an important task.”

### Ideal

- “I prefer a workable decision to a grand claim about how everyone should live.”

### Bond

- “I owe my former teacher proof that I can apply the lesson I once dismissed.”

### Flaw

- “I put off taking a side until others have already paid the cost of waiting.”

### Story

1. “I once caught someone taking what I was responsible for guarding. I let them leave with part of it after hearing their need, and replacing it myself cost me a privilege but preserved a life I later saw restored.”
2. “When two neighbors demanded my support, I repaired the shared damage without endorsing either accusation. The repair held, but their feud worsened, and I saw that solving the practical problem had not made me neutral.”
3. “I gather facts, preserve alternatives, and commit only when delay would cost more than a mistaken choice.”

### Traits

- “I arrange my belongings the same way whenever I stop to rest.”
- “I pause to collect my thoughts before beginning an important task.”

### Ideal

- “Curiosity deserves room to wander, but the people counting on me deserve warning before I wander away.”

### Bond

- “I owe my former teacher proof that I can apply the lesson I once dismissed.”

### Flaw

- “I treat a surprise invitation as a trap and sabotage plans before anyone can disappoint me.”

### Story

1. “When two people expected my help at the same time, I tried to satisfy both and failed one of them. I began naming which duties I had actually accepted, and now I ask what must give before I promise more.”
2. “When a festival locked me into a role I had outgrown, I traded places with a willing stranger and vanished into the crowd. I gained a day of freedom and left an organizer to explain the missing performer.”
3. “I pursue opportunities with room to improvise, but I name one obligation I will finish before the next novelty pulls me away.”
